Checked: YS-11 (6b3c3b98) is standing-migrator-after-complete (different); YS-12 (633f3485) is the phUSD-minter position left on old strategies (different); YS-03 (44dc0e3a, proposed-fixed) is SYA-not-repointed-to-V2 on the DEPLOY entry (different root cause + different entryPoint + opposite direction: YS-03 = V2 never added; this = olds never removed + wrong instance). New entry points (migrate:ys-sya-deregister, migrate:ys-old-strategy-decommission) have no prior baseline, so this cannot be a regression. Per-entryPoint fingerprint is distinct from all open entries.
findings.knownIssueAnalysis: NOT suppressed. Known-issue #9 ('External vault/yield strategy behavior (out of scope)') does NOT apply — the defect is an in-repo migration-SCRIPT wrong-address constant, not behavior internal to the external strategy/accumulator. Known-issue #10 (admin trust for registering strategies) does NOT apply — this is a non-obvious wrong-target footgun, not an owner trust assumption.
findings.threeLawAnalysis: IN SCOPE per Law 1/Law 3. A competent non-malicious operator running the documented runbook would be SURPRISED that the cleanup tail silently no-ops on an empty decommissioned SYA (owner-equality preflight + post-asserts all pass green) and then bricks the canonical yield-claim path. Surprise => footgun => report. Self-inflicted availability DoS (no funds stolen).

findings.title: story-067 zero-haircut FLOOR measures the buffer-inflated strategy principalOf, not user-withdrawable totalStaked, so a genuine per-user haircut passes the gate even on a CLEAN run
findings.reconciliationNote: NEW and KEPT DISTINCT from DEDUP-15-002 (YS-26). Confirmed genuinely different defect: this is the gate measuring the WRONG QUANTITY (principalOf includes the protocol-owned skim buffer, which dwarfs and masks a per-user haircut) and it fails even on a CLEAN run with a correct non-zero anchor; YS-26 is the anchor-ZEROING resume path. Complementary, not duplicate. Also distinct from ledger YS-05/5c9f1cee (leg2 ~0.026% redeposit haircut, open Low) which is the haircut MAGNITUDE; this is the GATE-BLINDNESS to it. Cross-link only.
findings.threeLawAnalysis: IN SCOPE as Low. On the ERC4626 autoDOLA/autoUSD strategies the round-trip haircut is bounded to redeem-rounding dust (~0.024%) and the buffer always exceeds it, so impact is Low. Documented amplification risk: a future YS-swap reusing this gate against an AMM/market strategy with real slippage would let a materially larger haircut pass the blind gate. Keep as Low operational/intent-mismatch.

proposedLedgerStatusFlips.title: tempPauser zero-gate in PostMigrationCleanup always reverts on a valid prod run after a clean Step 1
proposedLedgerStatusFlips.evidence: Fix-verifier VERDICT=FIXED. PostMigrationCleanup.s.sol:382-385 dropped the spurious '&& recordedTempPauser != address(0)'; a freshly-deployed StableStaker legitimately has pauser==address(0) (StableStaker.sol:55 uninitialized), so the recorded zero is valid and flows to a harmless setPauser(tempStaker,0) no-op on the decommissioned temp staker. Genuinely-missing key still fails loud via require(tempPauserRecorded). origPauser non-zero gate preserved; live staker pauser==0x7c5A... so origPauser gate is satisfiable. No new hole.
